classification: Game adaptation; quoted nominal values are public game data, not measured real-vehicle armour performance.

used_for: 100/80/45 hull and 200/155/65 turret nominal armour game reference

references.used_for: Related Soviet T-54/T-55 optic family reference only; not proof of exact Type 59 engraving.

scope.gunner: Original schematic reticle inspired by the related optical family; 3.5x–7x game zoom, vertical stabilization only.
scope.commander: Original schematic cross/lead marks; 1x–5x game zoom, unstabilized.

limitations: Armour uses per-plate scalar proxies with the model normals; not a full volumetric protection analysis.
Power, mass, damage, stock and regenerative supply are game settings.
No internal crew damage volumes or manually operated loading station.
